spans.s: बिंदु m. 1. A drop, a particle, संक्षिप्यते यशो लोके घृतबिंदुरिवांभसि M.vii.34, or विस्तीर्यते यशो लोके तैलबिंदुरिवांभसि M.vii.33; 2. a dot, a point; 3. a cipher (in math.), न रोमकूपौघमिषाज्जगत्कृता कृताश्च किं दूषणशून्यबिंदवः Na.i.21.
बिंदु-चित्रक m. the spotted antelope.
बिंदु-जाल, -जालक n. 1. a collection of particles or drops; 2. red mark; 3. on the trunk of an elephant.
बिंदु-जाल, -जालक n. 1. a collection of particles or drops; 2. red mark; 3. on the trunk of an elephant.
बिंदु-तंत्र m. 1. a die; 2. a chess-board.
बिंदु-देव m. an epithet of Śiva.
बिंदु-पत्र m. a species of birch tree.
बिंदु-फल n. a pearl.
बिंदु-रेखक m. 1. an anusvāra; 2. a kind of bird.
बिंदु-रेखा f. a row of dots.
बिंदु-वासर m. the day of conception.
बिंब (I) m.n. 1. The disc of the sun or moon, राहूपरागपरिमुक्तमिवेंदुबिंबम् Ch.
; 2. a disc in general, नितंबबिंबैः सदुकूलमेखलैः Rt.i.4; 3. an image, a shadow; 4. a mirror; 5. a jar; 6. an object to which another is compared, (op. to प्रतिबिंब).

बिंब (II) n. A kind of fruit; (when ripe, it is very red and is often used by poets to describe the colour of the lips of a young beautiful lady, तन्वी श्यामा शिखरिदशना पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठी Megh.ii.19, उमामुखे बिंबफलाधरोष्ठे K.S.iii.67).
बिंब-ओष्ठ m. (forming बिंबोष्ठ or बिंबौष्ठ) a lip like the bimba fruit.
बिंब-फल n. the fruit of the bimba, K.S.iii.67.
बिंबक n. 1. The disc of the sun or moon; 2. the fruit of the bimba.
बिंबिका f. 1. The disc of the sun or moon; 2. the Bimba plant.
बिंबित a. (f. ता) Reflected, imaged, shadowed.
बिंबित a. (f. ता) Reflected, imaged, shadowed.
